assets.title: Week 4 garment-detail overview board
assets.description: An overview board with several adult-oriented garments from Week 3 categories, each showing clear visible details such as buttons, pockets, collars, sleeves, waistbands, or zippers for quick review and detail noticing.
assets.notes: Use for the opener only. Keep garments large enough for students to notice one visible detail immediately.

assets.title: Garment-parts vocabulary board A
assets.description: A close-up educational vocabulary board showing collar, neckline, sleeve, cuff, shoulder, pocket, and button as separate detail visuals.
assets.notes: Main Week 4 detail board for upper-garment parts and small visible details.

assets.title: Garment-parts vocabulary board B
assets.description: A close-up educational vocabulary board showing zipper, waistband, hem, seam, pleat, dart, and lining as separate detail visuals.
assets.notes: Use as the second Week 4 detail board and keep all detail edges easy to recognize.

assets.title: Single labeled-points garment image
assets.description: One clear shirt or jacket image with visible point markers for collar, sleeve, buttons, pocket, zipper, hem, front, and seam.
assets.notes: Point markers should support app-checkable labels A through H, with distinct markers for the hem label and the separate bottom-location question.

assets.title: Reusable garment-detail card set
assets.description: A reusable card or gallery set showing four garments with clearly visible details: a white shirt with buttons, a black jacket with zipper and pockets, a blue skirt with waistband and pleats, and a red dress with neckline and back zipper.
assets.notes: One shared asset should support listening, writing choice, and teacher-led speaking.

assets.title: What Does It Have listening audio
assets.description: A short teacher-style audio clip with four garment descriptions that exactly match the Week 4 listening answer key.
assets.notes: Keep the script aligned exactly with the app-checked answers. Teacher read-aloud can substitute until audio is generated.
